back_ears: WHEN an unauthenticated user requests admin.xhtml THE SYSTEM SHALL redirect to login.xhtml.
WHEN a user with role CONSEILLER or CLIENT requests admin.xhtml THE SYSTEM SHALL redirect to dashboard.xhtml.
WHEN a user with role ADMIN requests admin.xhtml THE SYSTEM SHALL grant access to all administration sections.
matrix.consequence: contrôle d'accès RBAC côté serveur uniquement — aucune règle front équivalente
